# Kartik R Mathur

> Software Engineer portfolio — Java & Kotlin, Spring Boot microservices, Microsoft Azure, Docker/Kubernetes, and Android. 4+ years shipping production systems at Deloitte, Tata Elxsi, and Jio (125M+ users). Kartik R Mathur builds resilient digital infrastructure and high-performance engineering systems. He specializes in microservices architecture, cloud-native Azure deployments, enterprise API integration, and scalable Android applications with Clean Architecture.
